name: Liliane Daoud
title: Senior media professional and broadcast trainer
bio_short: Senior broadcast journalist with 20+ years' experience at BBC Arabic, ONTV and Alaraby TV. Bilingual presenter and interviewer. Trains executives in media, public speaking and communication under pressure.
bio: Liliane Daoud is a senior broadcast journalist and communication trainer with more than 20 years' experience in television and radio across the United Kingdom and the Arab world. She spent six years at the BBC World Service and BBC Arabic before presenting a flagship political talk show on ONTV in Egypt and joining Alaraby TV in London as a senior presenter. Alongside broadcasting, Liliane has spent more than a decade as a trainer and communication consultant, and is a visiting lecturer at the University of Westminster. Her work spans media training, spokesperson readiness, public speaking, leadership communication and strategic messaging. At ISOC, Liliane delivers media training, public speaking and communication programmes for executives and spokespeople. Her years in live political broadcasting give her training a direct, practical authority, particularly for leaders who must communicate clearly under scrutiny. Liliane is based in London and trains in English and Arabic.
bio_long: Liliane Daoud is a senior broadcast journalist and communication trainer with more than 20 years' experience in television and radio across the United Kingdom and the Arab world. She joined the BBC World Service in 2005 as a senior broadcast journalist, presenting and producing live English and Arabic programmes for BBC Arabic and BBC radio and covering international stories including the 2008 United States elections. She went on to present a flagship political talk show on ONTV in Egypt during a period of significant regional upheaval, and later spent five years as a senior presenter at Alaraby TV in London, interviewing public figures in demanding live environments. Alongside her broadcasting career, Liliane has worked for more than a decade as a trainer and communication consultant, and is a visiting lecturer at the University of Westminster in London. She designs and delivers practical short courses for government, public sector, corporate and international audiences, covering media training, spokesperson readiness, public speaking, crisis communication, stakeholder messaging and leadership communication. Her assignments have included advisory and training work connected to international and development organisations including UNDP and Free Press Unlimited. At ISOC, Liliane delivers media training, public speaking and communication programmes for executives and spokespeople across government, corporate and international organisations. Her combination of senior broadcast experience and bilingual delivery makes her particularly effective with leaders who operate in both English and Arabic and who must handle media and public scrutiny with composure. Years of presenting live political television give her a first-hand understanding of how to stay clear and credible under pressure. Liliane is based in London and trains in English and Arabic.
